backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing task CRUD with RBAC checks, storing tasks in a map and enforcing owner/admin access rules.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking UI debranding tasks to specific frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all major frontend files including components, hooks, docs, and styling.
frontend/docs/api-reference.md: API reference documenting authentication, RBAC, and task management endpoints.
frontend/docs/postman_collection.json: Postman collection defining example requests for authentication and task API endpoints.
frontend/docs/scaling-and-deployment.md: Guide explaining Internet Computer canisters, scaling, call types, and deployment considerations.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining OKLCH color system and light/dark theme tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML template loading the React application entry point.
frontend/README.md: Frontend project README outlining features, prerequisites, and local development setup.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring TanStack Router with login, dashboard, redirects, and theming.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI component showing an access-denied message with navigation back to login.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Layout wrapper with header, auth-aware navigation buttons, main content, and footer.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal prompting first‑time users for a name and saving the profile via mutation.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.t: Route guard that redirects unauthenticated users to login and shows an access denied screen.
frontend/src/features/auth/README.md: Overview of authentication features using Internet Identity, profile setup, and route protection.
frontend/src/features/tasks/README.md: Documentation for tasks feature structure, hooks, CRUD UI, and extension guidelines.
frontend/src/features/tasks/taskHooks.ts: React Query hooks for listing, creating, updating, and deleting tasks via the backend actor.
frontend/src/features/tasks/TasksInsight: Displays task statistics such as totals, active, completed, and overdue using fetched task data.
frontend/src/features/tasks/TasksPanel.t: Main task management UI supporting filtering, sorting, creation, editing, and deletion of tasks.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to identity changes and invalidates dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, managing login, logout, and identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and updating the caller's user profile, role, and admin status using an actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind base styles and defines light/dark theme variables and global typography utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays the authenticated dashboard, loading user profile data and showing profile, role, insights, and tasks panels.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Provides an Internet Identity login screen with error handling and redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom color variables, typography, container settings, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing features, requirements, architecture notes, and versioned state information.
